name: page_routes

state.task: Decide about the attached image of one scanned page.
state.collection: archaeological reports and related material from Czech archives, 1920–2020

source: #58 plan, B3 (v2, 2026-11-08): elements asked, processor tags computed from them; gold: elements from atrium_vocab.COLLECTIONS['page-category'], tags and primary from the hub's 'What each category suggests doing next'

has_printed_text.instructions: Does the page carry printed or machine-typed text (body text, headings, captions or labels)?

has_handwriting.instructions: Does the page carry handwritten text or numbers (notes, labels or filled-in entries)?

has_table_form.instructions: Is any part of the page a table, a form, a ledger grid or a tabular legend?

has_filled_fields.instructions: Does the page have form fields, blanks or stamp boxes filled in by hand or by typewriter?

has_photo.instructions: Does the page show a photograph or a photographic cutout?

has_drawing.instructions: Does the page show a drawing, map, plan, section or schematic?

has_stamp.instructions: Does the page carry a stamp or seal impression?

criteria.ocr: printed or machine-typed text recognition: the page is mainly printed or typed text
criteria.htr: handwritten text recognition: the page is mainly handwritten text
criteria.tables: table or form extraction: the page is mainly a table, a form, a ledger or a filled-in stamp
criteria.graphics: graphics detection and extraction: the page is mainly photographs, drawings, maps or plans

primary_route.instructions: Which further processor matters most for this page?
